skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply principles of information security, including vulnerability assessment and penetration testing.
Develop critical thinking skills to analyze and solve complex security issues.
Apply problem-solving techniques to identify and mitigate security vulnerabilities.
Conduct independent research on security assessment methodologies and tools.
Collaborate effectively in teams to perform security assessments and penetration tests.
Manage projects related to security assessments and penetration testing.
Write reports and documentation for security assessments and penetration tests.
Perform cybersecurity tasks, including vulnerability scanning and penetration testing.
Analyze and secure network systems against potential threats.
Conduct comprehensive security assessments to identify system weaknesses.
Execute penetration tests to evaluate system security.
Utilize various security tools and software for assessment and testing.
Apply ethical hacking techniques to identify and exploit security vulnerabilities.
Develop and implement security policies and procedures.
Perform security audits to ensure compliance with standards.
Assess and manage security risks within an organization.
Respond to security incidents and breaches effectively.
Promote security awareness and best practices within an organization.
